nodes.label: Turborepo monorepo with npm workspaces вЂ” apps/backend (NestJS 11 + Prisma 6 + Neon) + apps/frontend (Vite + React 18 + Tailwind 4 + TanStack Query + i18next)
nodes.rationale: Native-first workflow replacing Docker-heavy dev; turbo dev starts both apps in ~5s vs 2-5min Docker startup

nodes.label: Migration from Docker Compose (4 services: app, frontend, test-app, db/Postgres15) to native-first Turborepo with Neon cloud DB
nodes.rationale: Docker: 2-5 min startup, 5-10s HMR, hard DB resets. Native: ~5s startup, instant HMR, cloud-persisted DB. Eliminated docker-compose.yml dependency for daily dev

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml вЂ” 4 services: app (backend), frontend (React), test-app, db (PostgreSQL 15) with volume mounts for uploads and pg_data
nodes.rationale: Legacy Docker dev stack preserved for reference; no longer primary dev workflow

nodes.label: Neon Serverless PostgreSQL вЂ” hosted, pooled connections, ?sslmode=require, no local Postgres in dev, db push preferred over migrate dev when drifted
nodes.rationale: Eliminates Docker Postgres container; cloud-persisted means no data loss on reset; pooled connections better for serverless

nodes.label: JWT auth via httpOnly cookie with sameSite:lax вЂ” token never in localStorage, jwt.strategy reads cookies first then Bearer fallback, 1-day expiry
nodes.rationale: httpOnly prevents XSS token theft; sameSite:lax blocks cross-site AJAX which is why Vite proxy is required

nodes.label: Vite dev server proxy вЂ” /api and /socket.io proxied to backend target from VITE_API_URL env, changeOrigin:true, ws:true
nodes.rationale: Frontend on :3001 and backend on :3000 are different sites; httpOnly cookies with sameSite:lax are NOT sent cross-site. Proxy makes all requests same-origin so cookies work

nodes.label: CSRF double-submit cookie pattern вЂ” GET /api/auth/csrf-token issues token+cookie, X-CSRF-Token header must match csrf-token cookie on POST/PATCH/DELETE/PUT, skipped in dev mode
nodes.rationale: httpOnly cookies sent automatically; CSRF prevents cross-site request forgery. Skipped in dev for DX

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md вЂ” primary AI guidance file: menu options JSON schema, loyalty rate semantics, never hardcode tier thresholds, never Promise.all inside $transaction, never change api.ts baseURL, JWT cookie rules, CSRF middleware ordering
nodes.author: QR Menu Dev
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for AI agents working on codebase; contains all critical architectural rules and gotchas

nodes.label: CODING_ROADMAP.md вЂ” comprehensive feature roadmap: V1 MVP (auth, restaurant CRUD, menu, tables/QR, ordering, dashboard), V2 Premium (analytics, feedback, dayparting, translation, realtime, upselling), V2.5 (image upgrade, branding, menu check, mobile UX), V3 Growth (staff roles, multi-location), V4 Enterprise (AWS/GCP, Redis, POS integrations)
nodes.rationale: All phases tracked with files changed, status, and links to implementation transcripts

nodes.label: Developer setup guide вЂ” 5 steps: npm install, .env config (Neon URL + JWT_SECRET), prisma db push, npm run dev, access frontend :3001 + backend :3000
nodes.rationale: Onboarding guide for new developers; explains auth architecture, Vite proxy, CSRF protection, and troubleshooting

nodes.label: Waiter POS specification вЂ” /staff/pos route, PosLayout zero-padding full-viewport, Category Quick-Filter, 1-tap add-to-cart, Table Selector modal, Seat-Level Ordering, Rapid Modifiers bottom sheet, Course Firing toggle, Split Bill Calculator, QR Bill Generation
nodes.rationale: Architectural spec for Phase 4 tableside POS; staff-role protected, reuses CartContext/OrderContext/SocketContext, Tailwind + Radix UI, dark-mode compatible, zero animation bloat

nodes.label: FIFO point ledger loyalty program вЂ” earn/redeem rates (loyaltyExchangeRate default 10, loyaltyRedeemRate default 150), Silver/Gold VIP tiers (500/2000 point thresholds), Happy Hour multipliers (Math.max with tier, not additive), expiry reminder cron at midnight UTC, timezone-aware via Luxon
nodes.rationale: Most heavily modified subsystem. 5 bugs fixed in May 2026 rewrite (FIFO ledger, configurable VIP tiers, 5 more bugs May 3 audit). Rated 98/100.

nodes.label: loyalty-tiers.utils.ts вЂ” getTierInfo() and tierConfigFromRestaurant(), never hardcode thresholds (500/2000) anywhere
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for tier info; thresholds read from Restaurant row, not hardcoded

nodes.label: loyalty-ledger.utils.ts вЂ” FIFO operations: expireAccountPoints, redeemAccountPoints, addEarnedPointBatch, getExpiringPointBatches(onlyUnnotified), markRemindersSent. Critical rule: never Promise.all inside $transaction
nodes.rationale: Promise.all inside $transaction causes race conditions; use updateMany instead

nodes.label: Loyalty rate semantics вЂ” loyaltyExchangeRate (Int, default 10): points earned per 1 spent; loyaltyRedeemRate (Int, default 150): points needed for 1 discount; effective cashback = earnRate/redeemRate * 100, defaults give 6.7%
nodes.rationale: @Max(100) enforced on loyaltyExchangeRate; initial migration had DEFAULT 20, corrected to 10 in migration 20260503200750

nodes.label: Happy hour points multiplier вЂ” uses Luxon with restaurant IANA timezone field (never raw new Date()), multiplier strategy is Math.max(happyHour, tier), not additive
nodes.rationale: Timezone-aware prevents server UTC mismatches; Math.max prevents double-dipping on happy hour + VIP tier

nodes.label: MenuOption.choices JSON schema вЂ” always [{name: string, priceModifier: number}], no id field, price key is priceModifier NOT price
nodes.rationale: Critical schema constraint affecting every layer: DB/seed, ItemWithOptions, orders.service validation, CartContext totals. Wrong field name throws Invalid choice selected for every order with options

nodes.label: Server-side choice validation in orders.service.ts вЂ” matches c.name === selected.choiceName and reads choice.priceModifier
nodes.rationale: Never change to c.id or choice.price вЂ” those fields don't exist

nodes.label: 26 TypeScript errors from Prisma schema drift вЂ” AvailabilityType not exported, timezone/availabilityType/startTime/endTime/daysOfWeek missing from DB, stale path mappings in tsconfig.json forcing old Prisma client
nodes.rationale: Fixed by creating migration 20260422054424_add_availability_and_timezone and removing stale path mappings in tsconfig.json

nodes.label: Migration adding availability and timezone fields вЂ” availabilityType, startTime, endTime, daysOfWeek columns to support dayparting/scheduled categories
nodes.rationale: Dayparting feature required these fields but schema was out of sync with generated Prisma client

nodes.label: Docker build cache staleness вЂ” Docker's cached layers prevented new endpoints from deploying, anonymous volumes masked /dist directory
nodes.rationale: Multiple times new endpoints existed in source but not container. Fixed by .dockerignore excluding dist/ and node_modules/ + docker compose down -v

nodes.label: Backend package.json missing dev script вЂ” npm run dev from root failed because backend had no 'dev' script
nodes.rationale: Added 'dev': 'nest start --watch' to backend package.json

nodes.label: Platform-managed DeepL translation вЂ” 3 paths: (1) fire-and-forget pre-warm on menu create/update, (2) owner-triggered Translate All via POST /api/restaurants/:id/translate-all, (3) lazy on-demand via GET /api/menu/public/:id?lang=<code> caching to DB translations JSON
nodes.rationale: Platform owns DeepL key (DEEPL_API_KEY env var); restaurant.deeplApiKey column exists in schema but never read/written; free-tier detection via key ending in :fx routes to api-free.deepl.com

nodes.label: User report of untranslated strings across public menu, checkout, dashboard tabs, settings, home page вЂ” duplicated language picker, missing i18n keys, cart language stale on switch
nodes.rationale: Led to ~120 new i18n keys across EN/BG/RO plus cart language sync fix

nodes.label: Cart language sync вЂ” resolveItemName() looks up live translated name from categories prop by item ID + lang key, bypassing stale add-time name snapshot
nodes.rationale: Cart items stored name at add-time; switching language made cart show stale language. Fix: resolveItemName in CartDrawer reads current translation

nodes.label: VARIATION pre-selection in ItemWithOptions вЂ” useEffect keyed on item.id auto-selects first choice for every VARIATION option on modal open; ADD_ON remain unselected
nodes.rationale: Prevents ordering base item without selecting required variant

nodes.label: QR code print layout вЂ” single-column A4 portrait, page-break-inside:avoid on each card, @page { size: A4 portrait; margin: 12mm }, 2 tables per page without cross-page cuts
nodes.rationale: Previous grid-cols-2 layout caused cross-page cuts

nodes.label: Recharts dark mode вЂ” XAxis/YAxis tick fills changed from 'currentColor' to explicit 'hsl(var(--color-muted-foreground))', custom ChartTooltip with glass-panel styling
nodes.rationale: currentColor was invisible on dark backgrounds

nodes.label: Menu health check false positive вЂ” deleted category-image audit rule from menu.service.ts, no UI exists to add category images
nodes.rationale: Audit rule flagged missing category images but no upload UI existed for them

nodes.label: AI menu import feature вЂ” Gemini API with JSON schema enforcement, HITL validation via TanStack Table, Prisma bulk operations, multi-step pipeline: upload -> OCR/structure -> review/edit -> import
nodes.rationale: Production-grade AI ingestion for restaurant menus; solves biggest onboarding friction (manual menu entry)

nodes.label: Gemini API integration for menu OCR вЂ” structured JSON output with schema enforcement, Bulgarian menu image processing to canonical schema
nodes.rationale: Gemini chosen for structured output reliability with JSON schema mode

nodes.label: Human-in-the-loop validation UI вЂ” TanStack Table for editable grid review of AI-extracted menu items before import
nodes.rationale: AI extraction isn't perfect; HITL ensures accuracy before data hits production DB

nodes.label: Comprehensive bug fix log вЂ” 20+ resolved issues: stale cart cleanup, scroll jump, perfect pairing flow, CSS hsla() fix, image upload overhaul, live table view fixes, POS bugs, security hardening
nodes.rationale: Chronological record of all bug fixes with root causes and resolutions

nodes.label: Stale cart pruneInvalidItems() вЂ” removes items where category or item no longer exists in current menu data
nodes.rationale: Menu updates could leave cart with ghost items referencing deleted categories/items

nodes.label: Menu scroll position fix вЂ” scroll position preserved after add-to-cart action, no category jumping
nodes.rationale: Add-to-cart caused menu to jump to different category; fixed by stabilizing scroll container refs

nodes.label: Perfect pairing UX fix вЂ” pairing modal opens BEFORE item is added to cart, not after
nodes.rationale: Previous flow: add to cart -> pairing modal -> confusing. New flow: Add to Cart -> pairing modal opens first -> upsell selection -> cart updated

nodes.label: CSS hsla() syntax fix вЂ” .text-glow and .premium-bg changed to color-mix(in srgb, var(--token) N%, transparent) instead of invalid hsla(var(...)) syntax
nodes.rationale: Tailwind v4 CSS variables use space-separated HSL values; hsla(var(--x)) is invalid CSS

nodes.label: Cloudflare R2 + sharp WebP image pipeline вЂ” EXIF auto-rotate, resize to 1200px max, convert to WebP quality 82, 400px thumbnail quality 75, parallel upload, JPEG/PNG/WebP validation
nodes.rationale: 80-95% size reduction; replaces local disk uploads with cloud storage

nodes.label: CartDrawer React Portal fix вЂ” cart rendered at body root with z-index:10000 instead of being child of Action Bar (squashed to tiny window)
nodes.rationale: CartDrawer was child of constrained parent container, showing only header and X button in tiny window

nodes.label: Checkout order submission failure вЂ” OrdersService.create transactional integrity improved, validation hardened for options and pricing
nodes.rationale: Server-side price validation prevented orders with mismatched client-side calculated totals

nodes.label: Live Tables View code review fixes вЂ” parallel DB queries replacing sequential awaits, emitTableStatusChanged helper deduplication across 4 call sites, removed unused label field, enabled guard on useQuery
nodes.rationale: Sequential queries caused N+1 latency; socket emission was duplicated across 4 places

nodes.label: Waiter POS bug fixes вЂ” duplicate menuItemId in order, session history not loading, dashboard live view not fetching table orders, cart not resetting on table switch, confirmation dialogs not closing
nodes.rationale: 5 bug fix commits after initial POS deployment

nodes.label: Security hardening вЂ” httpOnly JWT cookies, CSRF double-submit, Content-Security-Policy headers, Helmet, per-endpoint rate limits, CORS locked to FRONTEND_URL, X-Content-Type-Options/X-Frame-Options/Referrer-Policy headers
nodes.rationale: Stack: Helmet CSP -> cookieParser -> CSRF validation -> global pipes. CSRF skipped in dev mode and for Stripe webhook path

nodes.label: UI polish and localization fixes вЂ” AssistanceView JSX error (duplicate children), OrdersView missing NotificationBell import, PublicMenuPage ref assignment, i18next setup with EN/BG/RO, menu editor redesign
nodes.rationale: Batch fix transcript covering JSX bugs, missing imports, ref patterns, and locale setup

nodes.label: Phases 9-12 implementation transcript вЂ” analytics with Recharts, feedback system with Google Review redirect, dayparting with timezone-aware scheduling, multi-language DeepL translation, Docker build debugging
nodes.rationale: 2,490-line transcript of V2 Premium feature builds

nodes.label: Architecture migration transcript вЂ” directory restructure (monorepo layout), Neon DB integration replacing Docker Postgres, Turborepo setup with npm workspaces, prisma.config.js deletion, backend dev script fix

nodes.label: Email OTP authentication system вЂ” VerificationToken model (id, email, bcrypt-hashed 6-digit code, 10-min expiry, 60s rate-limit), Resend REST API for production, devCode fallback for local dev

nodes.label: Tables modal crash fix вЂ” table fetch errors caused white screen; improved error boundaries and fallback states
nodes.rationale: Modal crashed on API errors instead of showing error state

nodes.label: Demo restaurant dataset вЂ” rich menu with categories, items, options, allergens, pricing; used for testing and onboarding
nodes.rationale: Demo data essential for testing all features without manual entry

nodes.label: App analysis and improvement suggestions вЂ” learning platform analysis (not related to QR Menu, appears to be a different project analysis mixed in)
nodes.rationale: 327-line analysis; content appears to be about a different application (learning platform)

nodes.label: Public menu scrolling issue вЂ” iOS Safari momentum scroll + fixed position elements layout shift, viewport height calculation with 100dvh
nodes.rationale: iOS Safari has unique viewport behavior with bottom bars; 100dvh and position:fixed need careful handling

nodes.label: RestaurantContext missing fetchRestaurants export вЂ” caused silent crash after settings save, no error feedback to user
nodes.rationale: Failed to save settings had no visible error; root cause was missing method export

nodes.label: SortableItem drag listeners blocking clicks вЂ” all click events captured by drag listeners on root div, preventing menu interactions
nodes.rationale: Fixed by restricting drag listeners to grip handle only instead of entire root div

nodes.label: Database reset losing all data вЂ” docker compose down -v cleared PostgreSQL volume, immediate reseed with demo data (demo@codespaces.com / codespaces2026)
nodes.rationale: Docker volume removal is destructive; reseeding necessary after -v flag

nodes.label: Stripe Connect pay-at-table вЂ” IPaymentProvider interface abstraction, StripeProvider implementation, PaymentService session lifecycle, PaymentIntent creation, webhook handler with idempotency via stripePaymentIntentId lookup, raw body preservation for signature verification
nodes.rationale: Provider abstraction allows future MyPOS/Square integration without changing business logic

nodes.label: TableSession model вЂ” groups orders per browser session token, statuses: OPEN/PAID/CLOSED_NO_PAYMENT, created/updated timestamps
nodes.rationale: Session groups all orders for a table visit; payment flows transition status through lifecycle

nodes.label: IPaymentProvider interface вЂ” abstracts StripeProvider, future MyPOS, Square implementations; methods: createPaymentIntent, handleWebhook, getPaymentStatus
nodes.rationale: Never add provider-specific logic outside the provider вЂ” always go through IPaymentProvider

nodes.label: Socket.io EventsGateway вЂ” emits table:status-changed (4 call sites: OrdersService.create, OrdersService.updateStatus, PaymentService.handleWebhookEvent, PaymentService.closeSession), payment:confirmed, newOrder
nodes.rationale: Real-time updates across dashboard, live table view, and POS

nodes.label: Cloudflare R2 storage service вЂ” sharp image pipeline: EXIF rotate, resize 1200px, WebP quality 82, 400px thumbnail quality 75, parallel upload. ALLOWED_TYPES: JPEG/PNG/WebP
nodes.rationale: 80-95% file size reduction vs raw uploads; R2 is S3-compatible with zero egress fees

nodes.label: CSS design system вЂ” HSL color tokens (color-surface, color-text, color-accent, color-muted-foreground), 2-font stack (Outfit + Playfair Display), .glass-panel, .premium-bg with color-mix(), reduced-motion support
nodes.rationale: Warm restaurant color palette; dropped Plus Jakarta Sans to reduce font loading; fixed invalid hsla() syntax

nodes.label: Mobile UX patterns вЂ” viewport-fit=cover, iOS PWA meta tags, bottom navigation on dashboard mobile, safe-area insets, CartDrawer as bottom sheet, 375px PublicMenuPage optimization, checkout responsive padding
nodes.rationale: PWA-first mobile UX; layout routes in App.tsx separate customer vs dashboard chrome

nodes.label: AuthContext вЂ” no localStorage token (httpOnly cookie only), reads user via /auth/me which sends cookie automatically, loginWithToken(token, user) stores token + sets axios header without extra API call
nodes.rationale: Never read token from localStorage; /auth/me is the single source of truth for current user

nodes.label: API client (api.ts) вЂ” axios instance, baseURL /api (same-origin, Vite proxy), withCredentials:true, CSRF interceptor fetches token once and caches, 401 interceptor redirects to /login EXCEPT for /auth/me (returns rejected promise to prevent logout loop)
nodes.rationale: Critical: NEVER change baseURL to read from VITE_API_URL directly вЂ” that creates cross-origin requests breaking httpOnly cookies

nodes.label: Dayparting (scheduled category visibility) вЂ” HIDDEN/ALWAYS/SCHEDULED modes, dayOfWeek array + time window with overnight range support (e.g., 22:00-02:00), Luxon timezone-aware
nodes.rationale: Restaurants need time-based menu switching (breakfast/lunch/dinner); overnight ranges critical for late-night venues

nodes.label: Smart analytics dashboard вЂ” revenue trends, peak hours, category breakdown, order stats, CSV export with UTF-8 BOM for Excel Cyrillic support; staleTime:0 for freshness, socket-driven cache invalidation
nodes.rationale: Timezone-aware via Luxon with restaurant.timezone; socket events invalidate React Query cache for real-time updates

nodes.label: Customer feedback system вЂ” star rating + comment, Google Review redirect for 4+ stars, sentiment analysis, dashboard view with filtering
nodes.rationale: High ratings redirected to Google Reviews for social proof; low ratings kept internal for improvement

nodes.label: Restaurant branding editor вЂ” Google Fonts picker, 4-color scheme editor, WCAG AA contrast validator (4.5:1 minimum), live BrandingPreview panel, per-restaurant defaultTheme (light/dark), theme-toggle on public menu even with custom branding
nodes.rationale: Each restaurant gets independent theme stored in localStorage keyed by restaurantId; defaultTheme field on Restaurant schema

nodes.label: Menu health audit widget вЂ” /menu/audit/:id route, severity levels (error/warning/info), one-click fix navigation to problematic items/categories
nodes.rationale: Proactive menu quality tool; detects missing translations, low-res images, empty categories, pricing anomalies

nodes.label: Waiter POS at /staff/pos вЂ” third layout (PosLayout), StaffRoute guard (OWNER+STAFF), PosContext (in-memory, isolated from CartContext), PosCartItem.submitted flag for history/pending separation, 15 new frontend files + 4 backend endpoints
nodes.rationale: Full-viewport mobile-first tableside ordering; submitted flag critical for separating order history from pending items

nodes.label: PosCartItem.submitted boolean вЂ” separates order history (read-only, gray, checkmark) from pending items (full qty/note/delete controls): addItem sets false, markAsSubmitted sets all pending to true, setHistoryItems replaces submitted items, clearCart removes only pending, resetCart removes all
nodes.rationale: Core POS state design; enables viewing past orders while building new ones on same table

nodes.label: PaymentService methods вЂ” forceOpenSession() closes existing OPEN then creates new, closeSessionWithCard() creates MYPOS payment + sets PAID + emits socket events
nodes.rationale: 4 new backend endpoints for POS: session force-open, session close-card, bill history, force close no-payment

nodes.label: Multi-language support вЂ” EN/BG/RO locales, i18next with ~200+ keys covering all surfaces, fallbackLng bg, DeepL auto-translation with DB caching, lang validated against restaurant.targetLanguages
nodes.rationale: Bulgarian market primary; English as international fallback; Romanian for neighboring market

nodes.label: Prisma schema models вЂ” User(Role: CUSTOMER/STAFF/OWNER), Restaurant, RestaurantTable, MenuCategory, MenuItem, MenuOption(choices Json), Order, OrderItem, AssistanceRequest, TableSession, Payment, VerificationToken, LoyaltyPointLedger, Feedback, Translation
nodes.rationale: Full schema covering auth, menu, orders, payments, loyalty, feedback, translation storage

nodes.label: UserRole enum вЂ” CUSTOMER, STAFF, OWNER (planned expansion: MANAGER, KITCHEN for Phase 18 staff roles)
nodes.rationale: StaffRoute guard checks user.role === 'STAFF' || user.role === 'OWNER' for POS access

nodes.label: API baseURL rule вЂ” api.ts MUST use /api (same-origin), NEVER read from VITE_API_URL directly. VITE_API_URL is ONLY for vite.config.js proxy target
nodes.rationale: Breaking this rule creates cross-origin requests, breaking httpOnly cookies. Repeated in CLAUDE.md as CRITICAL

nodes.label: Token storage rule вЂ” NEVER read token from localStorage. Token lives in httpOnly cookie only. Use /auth/me to get current user
nodes.rationale: httpOnly cookies are not accessible to JavaScript; localStorage would defeat XSS protection

nodes.label: CSRF middleware ordering in main.ts вЂ” Helmet CSP -> cookieParser -> CSRF validation -> app.useGlobalPipes. CSRF must run after cookieParser but before guards
nodes.rationale: Order matters: cookieParser must parse cookies before CSRF can validate them; CSRF must validate before guards process request

nodes.label: Prisma $transaction rule вЂ” NEVER use Promise.all over Prisma writes inside $transaction. Use updateMany instead
nodes.rationale: Promise.all inside $transaction causes race conditions on sequential writes

nodes.label: Tier threshold rule вЂ” never hardcode tier thresholds (500/2000) anywhere. Read from Restaurant row through loyalty-tiers.utils.ts
nodes.rationale: Thresholds are configurable per restaurant; hardcoding would break multi-tenant

nodes.label: Frontend tier consumption rule вЂ” consume tier info directly from API, do not recompute on client. CustomerProfilePage and CheckoutPage read tier from server response
nodes.rationale: Server is source of truth for tier calculation; client recomputation would diverge

nodes.label: DeepL API key rule вЂ” platform owns key via DEEPL_API_KEY env var. TranslationService methods take NO apiKey param. restaurant.deeplApiKey column exists in schema but is NEVER read or written
nodes.rationale: Platform-managed translation; restaurants don't need their own DeepL key

nodes.label: Payment provider rule вЂ” never add provider-specific logic outside the provider. Always go through IPaymentProvider interface
nodes.rationale: Enables future MyPOS/Square integration without touching business logic

nodes.label: NestJS module registration order вЂ” Prisma, Auth, Restaurants, Menu, Orders, Assistance, Dashboard, Tables, Health, Feedback, Translation, Storage, Events, Payment, Loyalty. ScheduleModule registered only in loyalty.module.ts
nodes.rationale: Module order affects dependency injection and middleware chain

nodes.label: @Max(100) on loyaltyExchangeRate in update-restaurant.dto.ts вЂ” prevents absurd point awards, most common cause of inflated loyalty points
nodes.rationale: Do not remove this constraint; past bug: exchange rate crept to 20 from default 10, giving double points

nodes.label: Backend clean script uses Windows rmdir /s /q вЂ” cross-platform users need rm -rf dist manually
nodes.rationale: Windows-specific command in package.json; known gotcha for Mac/Linux devs

hyperedges.label: Auth Architecture: httpOnly Cookie + Vite Proxy + CSRF
hyperedges.description: Complete auth flow: JWT in httpOnly cookie (XSS-proof), same-origin via Vite proxy (sameSite:lax compatible), CSRF double-submit for state-changing requests, AuthContext reads user from /auth/me, api.ts baseURL hardcoded to /api

hyperedges.label: Loyalty Subsystem: FIFO Ledger + Configurable Tiers + Happy Hour
hyperedges.description: FIFO point ledger with expiry tracking, configurable VIP tiers (thresholds from DB, not hardcoded), Math.max(tier, happyHour) multiplier strategy, exchange/redeem rate semantics (@Max(100) on exchange rate), frontend consumes from API

hyperedges.label: Critical Architectural Rules (CLAUDE.md)
hyperedges.description: 8 critical rules enforced across codebase: never change api.ts baseURL, never read token from localStorage, CSRF middleware ordering, never Promise.all inside $transaction, never hardcode tier thresholds, consume tiers from API, platform DeepL key only, always use IPaymentProvider

hyperedges.label: Translation Gap Fixes Cluster
hyperedges.description: User-reported translation gaps led to: cart language sync (resolveItemName), options pre-selection defaults, QR A4 print layout, analytics dark mode Recharts colors, menu health false positive removal, ~120 new i18n keys

hyperedges.label: Docker/Infrastructure Bugs Chain
hyperedges.description: Docker caching caused stale compiled code (multiple occurrences), Prisma schema drift caused 26 TS errors, missing backend dev script broke turbo dev, docker compose down -v caused data loss. All motivated native-first migration

hyperedges.label: Waiter POS Architecture
hyperedges.description: Full-viewport tableside POS: StaffRoute guard, PosContext isolated state, submitted flag for history/pending separation, 3 session-end actions (Submit/Paid by Card/Force Close), 5 post-deploy bug fixes

hyperedges.label: Menu Options JSON Schema: Critical Contract
hyperedges.description: [{name, priceModifier}] schema вЂ” no id field, price key is priceModifier. Affects: DB seed, ItemWithOptions cart build, orders.service server validation, CartContext totals, AI import schema alignment

hyperedges.label: May 2026 Bug Fixes: Scroll, Cart, Checkout, UI
hyperedges.description: Bundle of bugs found and fixed: menu scroll position jumping, cart drawer squashed in DOM, pairing modal flow wrong order, stale cart items after menu updates, checkout validation failure, invalid hsla() CSS, tables modal crashes, missing context export, drag listeners blocking clicks

hyperedges.label: Payment Architecture Trinity
hyperedges.description: Stripe Connect handles customer self-payment, Waiter POS handles staff-assisted payment (MYPOS card close), both operate on same TableSession model (OPEN/PAID/CLOSED_NO_PAYMENT)

hyperedges.label: OCR Menu Import Data Pipeline
hyperedges.description: OCR tool extracts Bulgarian menus to canonical JSON; transformCanonicalToSaaSPayload splits tags using KNOWN_ALLERGENS; CSV parser re-splits raw tags identically; both paths feed SaaS_Menu_Import_API which upserts into Prisma schema

hyperedges.label: Three-Path Translation Design
hyperedges.description: Platform-managed DeepL key (no per-restaurant key); 3 paths: fire-and-forget pre-warm, Translate All, lazy on-demand; getPublicMenu calls lazy path; TranslationCompleteness filled ~120 missing i18next keys across EN/BG/RO

hyperedges.label: Customer Auth + UI Fixes Bundle
hyperedges.description: Single plan delivering OTP auth (Resend API), cart language sync, options pre-selection, analytics dark mode, profile nav, QR print layout вЂ” bundled as comprehensive bug-fix + feature shipment

hyperedges.label: Waiter POS Complete Component Tree
hyperedges.description: Full staff POS with auth guard, isolated context, table selection, seat-level ordering, options drawer, cart with split/QR, item notes serialized into specialRequests

hyperedges.label: Analytics Dark Mode + Timezone Fixes
hyperedges.description: Fixes: staleTime:0 for freshness, socket-driven cache invalidation, Luxon timezone-aware date/hour, dark mode chart colors via explicit CSS variables, CSV UTF-8 BOM export

hyperedges.label: Plan-Spec Document Pairs
hyperedges.description: Each design spec (docs/specs/*.md) paired with implementation plan (docs/plans/*.md): Analytics+Translation, Translation Completeness, Customer Auth+Fixes, Stripe Payments, Waiter POS
